title: Sit, Pig, Sit!
summary: A small pig learns to be brave when helping a friend find food, discovering its own strength.

pages.scene: A small pink pig resting peacefully in a pen
A thin cat hiding under hay, looking worried
Empty food dishes in the barn, cat looking distressed
Cat calling to pig desperately for help

pages.text: The pig ran. She did go.
pages.scene: Pig running quickly through the farmyard, determined
Pig discovering grain stored in an old hat on a shelf
Pig carefully bringing grain back to share

pages.text: We can do it. We did!
pages.scene: Pig and cat eating together, both happy and grateful
Pig and cat as heroes, their friendship stronger
